name: Miguel Alemán Valdés
contribution: A Mexican politician who served a full term as the President of Mexico from 1946 to 1952.

checks.lead: Miguel Alemán Valdés (Spanish pronunciation: [miˈɣel aleˈman] ; 29 September 1900 – 14 May 1983) was a Mexican politician who served a full term as the President of Mexico from 1946 to 1952. He was the first civilian president after a string of revolutionary generals.
